params.body:
On 26 September at 14:09:45 Garage Vanhees bought a Peugeot 3008 over from Garage Vanderheyden. The copy was made, the car moved, both sides were marked sold — and no row was written in `vehicle_history`.

That row is what both garages see under Administratie > Bestelbonnen > Bestelbonnen dealertransacties, so the transaction was invisible to both. And the two confirmation mails sit a few lines below it in the same method, so neither the seller nor the buyer was told anything. Nothing about it reached Nightwatch, open or resolved. A dealer had to phone.

That the purchase really went through `buy_over` is not a guess: the copy carries `seller_vehicle_id = 23098`, `seller_id = 256` and `purchase_price = 29000`, and only `Vehicle::buy_over` sets those.

## This does not fix the cause

I could not find out why `logHistory()` produced no row, so the finding stays **open**. What this changes is that the same failure can no longer happen in silence.

**The write can no longer take the mails with it.** `logHistory()` sat outside the `try` that guards the two mails. Either it throws and takes the whole purchase down, or — as here — the mails are skipped with it. It is now wrapped and reported, the purchase stands, and both parties are told, because the purchase did happen.

**A daily check states the invariant.** A vehicle with a `seller_vehicle_id` was bought over, so it has a history row. `stocklist:check-transactions` names every car that breaks that, reports once to Nightwatch and exits non-zero, daily at 06:40.

It deliberately repairs nothing. Writing the row would make a transaction appear in two dealers' screens with nobody deciding that, and of the two cases found today the older one dates from June 2025. `create:vehicle-history` already exists for the repair, by hand.

## Already repaired by hand

The Vanhees transaction has been written to production from the two vehicles' own data (seller 256, buyer 175, chassis `VR3KAHPY4TS039665`, €29.000, dated to the sale moment), so the bestelbon is back for both garages. The mails cannot be resent by this; the two garages need telling directly.

The second case, vehicle 14562 from June 2025, is **left alone** pending a decision — it would surface a fifteen-month-old bestelbon in two dealers' screens.

## Verified

Four tests: a bought-over car without its row is named and the command fails, one with its row is quiet, an ordinary car is never named (without which the check would report the whole stock), and `logHistory` stays inside a `try`.

New finding `2026-09-28-een-overkoop-liet-geen-spoor-na`, status open, severity `nu`, against R S5-3.5 and R S5-3.10.

`phpstan` green, `pint` green on the added files. Local suite: the same nine failures as on a clean `main` in my environment.
params.title: A bought-over car carries its transaction, or says so
